parsed.why: Only state to strip gender-identity civil-rights protection; 2026 bar on stronger local ordinances; listed in worst legal-risk tier. School birth-certificate restroom rule binds visitors on campus with no adult alternative. National document regime applies.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodations, employment and hate-crime coverage, no facility ban, working shield law for care. Only the parent's document/entry regime pulls it down — a genuine protective operating regime above the 0.35 national line.

Moderate tier: no statewide adult facility or care ban, but no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage for gender identity. Protections exist only in four municipalities covering 46% of population — mean local regime near the national 0.35, slightly under.

Youth care ban, hospital cancellation of adult surgery in 2025, and police describing epidemic-level killings of trans women — a state-acknowledged pattern. No documented facility ban or protections; violence figures are undercount floors. Below national average.

Hostile layer atop the parent: custody gender-care funding ban (reaches detained travellers), surgical-only birth-certificate rule with workaround reversed, licence reversion, sports ban, no nondiscrimination, anonymous tip line. Hate-crime and sanctuary-city positives only partly offset.
